input.content: Idempotency/recovery lookup keyed by the wrong field (P0 data-loss pattern). An operation keyed by a caller-supplied operation_id must be looked up by that id. Changing the lookup to scan by a coarser attribute (e.g., workspace) collapses all operations on that attribute onto the first record: a fresh operation_id finds a prior completed/applied record, skips create and apply, never records itself, and returns a hardcoded {"ok": True, "operation_id": <passed id>} — silent data loss plus false success. Symptom in review: `next((r for r in store.values() if r["attr"] == x), None)` replacing `store.get(id)`. Check contract: "a fresh ID must perform a fresh save even for the same <attr>".
